scenario: IRET.10.7 / LGRA.10.1.4: the nested withdraw removes exactly the fact the outer rule matched, by identity. `r` consumes its `Go` and calls. A second Job with the same values is asserted before the reply, and `r` does not fire for it, because the Go is gone. The reply's body withdraws `j` and emits a Check, and `left` logs once for each Job still live. So exactly one "left 1" means the matched Job went and its twin stayed. A withdraw by value that takes every equal Job gives [], and one that removes nothing gives two lines. So does one that withdraws the capture fact at the view's token position. PATH PINNED: ACTION_WITHDRAW_BY_ID through libds's `ds_rete_wm_find_by_id` (`rete/engine.c`), which names one fact.
rules_ds:
schema SvcReadReply scope ttl 1_h:
    corr: String
    ok: Bool

service svc.read:
    kwarg n: Int
    response SvcReadReply

schema Go scope explicit:
    n: Int

schema Job scope explicit:
    id: Int

schema Check scope explicit:
    v: Int

rule r:
    Go g
    Job j where j.id == g.n
->
    withdraw g
    call svc.read n: j.id cooldown: 1_min as "c1"
        on response.ok == true:
            withdraw j
            emit Check v: 1

rule left:
    Check c
    Job j where j.id == c.v
->
    log info "left {j.id}"
